title: OntoBoard: ODK and ROBOT ontology engineering inside Protégé Desktop

creators.name: Norouzi, Ebrahim
creators.affiliation: Information Service Engineering (ISE), FIZ Karlsruhe - Leibniz Institute for Information Infrastructure, Germany

description:
OntoBoard is a Protégé Desktop plugin for people who maintain OBO-style ontologies with the Ontology Development Kit (ODK) and ROBOT. It embeds robot-core 1.9.8 and runs ROBOT operations in process, against the ontology Protégé has open: report, measure, profile, explain, SPARQL, transform, export terms, template, rename IRIs and extract import modules.

It also scaffolds and builds ODK projects, compares two releases axiom by axiom, draws a canvas from the axioms actually asserted and explains what the reasoner concluded, bundles 163 ontology design patterns as OWL and Turtle, and wraps git and live shared editing sessions.

Requires Protégé Desktop 5.6.x or 5.5.0, and Java 8 or later.

This record archives the source tree of the tagged release. The installable plugin jar is attached to the corresponding GitHub release.
notes: The archived .zip is the source tree at the release tag, as generated by GitHub. The installable plugin jar (shaded, about 66 MB, containing ROBOT and its dependencies) is published as an asset of the corresponding GitHub release: https://github.com/ebrahimnorouzi/ontoboard/releases
